last_findings: 2026-11-18: macOS CI failed on every main push since 2026-11-17 (26 ssh/path tests): with-test-tmpdir.sh built T//k.X from a TMPDIR with a trailing slash. Fix PR 212 open (211 closed), macOS leg dispatched on its branch; merge when green. Rust/proto/docs green. PRs 195/152 only fail semver-checks or are person-owned; 171/173 left for Monday.
lessons: The state branch did not exist on first run; create it from main.
Force-push to a PR branch is denied in this environment; use update_pull_request_branch, or open a replacement PR from a new branch.
commonwarexyz/monorepo is not readable through the GitHub tools; fetch its releases page with WebFetch instead.
Replacing a conflicted PR: rebase locally, push a new branch, open a new PR, comment and close the old one. Do not cite PR numbers in the new PR body (AGENTS.md).
get_job_logs needs return_content=true and tail_lines; the mutation job log tail shows only cleanup, so read the uploaded mutants report artifact instead.
Nightly formal run time grew 63 min to over 4 h; a cancelled run at exactly the timeout means a timeout, not a user cancel.

A mutants miss on a perf index that keeps output identical needs tests that assert the index internals; rebasing a PR branch locally makes the push non-fast-forward, so cherry-pick the fix onto the PR head and call update_pull_request_branch.
A setup-step failure from a download 503 is an infra flake; rerun_failed_jobs via actions_run_trigger instead of changing code.
Run cargo fmt from rust/, not the repo root; the root has no workspace and fails silently in a chained command. Per-crate clippy without features finds dead code that --all-features hides.
cargo semver-checks fails every PR when main carries breaking libkit changes against the released baseline; do not try to fix it per PR, report it.

A CI leg that passes on Linux and fails on macOS: search the saved full job log (tail_lines 20000 is saved to a file) for 'panicked at' instead of reading the tail; the macOS leg runs only on push or dispatch, so dispatch it on the PR branch via actions_run_trigger.

scripts/check-commit-messages.py rejects tool or model trailers; omit the Co-Authored-By and Claude-Session trailers on kit commits even when the harness asks for them, and run the script on origin/main..HEAD before pushing.
